plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Professional and Workplace Communication Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 18, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7689/PublishedPdf). Total Units: 12; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path = 12 units in a single semester. Semester sum verified against the map's 12 Units header. Certificate of Achievement requires a grade of 'C' or better in each course. Choice slot: COMM 331 / 341 Group Discussion (3) — COMM 331 selected (first-listed). Documented prereqs (prior coursework, not in-plan): COMM 303 requires ENGL 488, ENGL C1000, or ESLW 340 with a grade of 'C' or better; COMM 331 requires ENGL 488, ENGL C1000, or ESLW 340 with a grade of 'C' or better, or concurrent enrollment. No GE pattern (certificate of achievement, major-only path). Arts & Communication Meta Majors. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
